svg.title: Floodhall Passage — A dry observation gallery beside submerged glyph arches
svg.desc: The dry gallery steps down alongside submerged door glyphs. Observation desks, service ladders and lamp platforms support the light-following activity without requiring diving.

Shared access · None hostile; aid creature 26–30
